changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE regional_price_observations ADD CONSTRAINT regional_price_observations_ck2 CHECK ( (sample_measurement_count IS NULL AND sample_day_count IS NULL AND sample_expected_day_count IS NULL AND sample_collected_at IS NULL) OR (sample_measurement_count IS NOT NULL AND sample_day_count IS NOT NULL AND sample_expected_day_count IS NOT NULL AND sample_collected_at IS NOT NULL AND sample_measurement_count >= sample_day_count AND sample_day_count BETWEEN 1 AND sample_expected_day_count AND sample_expected_day_count BETWEEN 1 AND 31) );
UPDATE archive_state SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = 1;

changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE benzup_measurements ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT benzup_measurements_pk PRIMARY KEY, region_id bigint NOT NULL, fuel_type_code varchar(16) NOT NULL, import_run_id bigint NOT NULL, observed_date date NOT NULL, price_rub_per_liter numeric NOT NULL, collected_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT benzup_measurements_uk1 UNIQUE (import_run_id, region_id, fuel_type_code), CONSTRAINT benzup_measurements_fk1 FOREIGN KEY (import_run_id) REFERENCES import_runs(id), CONSTRAINT benzup_measurements_fk2 FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES regions(id), CONSTRAINT benzup_measurements_fk3 FOREIGN KEY (fuel_type_code) REFERENCES fuel_types(code), CONSTRAINT benzup_measurements_ck1 CHECK ( price_rub_per_liter > 0 AND price_rub_per_liter NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND length(price_rub_per_liter::text) <= 64 AND observed_date = (collected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date ) ); CREATE INDEX benzup_measurements_fk2_idx ON benzup_measurements(region_id, observed_date); CREATE INDEX benzup_measurements_fk3_idx ON benzup_measurements(fuel_type_code);
CREATE TABLE benzup_daily_prices ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY CONSTRAINT benzup_daily_prices_pk PRIMARY KEY, region_id bigint NOT NULL, fuel_type_code varchar(16) NOT NULL, observed_date date NOT NULL, price_sum numeric NOT NULL, measurement_count integer NOT NULL, price_rub_per_liter numeric NOT NULL, collected_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT benzup_daily_prices_uk1 UNIQUE (region_id, fuel_type_code, observed_date), CONSTRAINT benzup_daily_prices_fk1 FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES regions(id), CONSTRAINT benzup_daily_prices_fk2 FOREIGN KEY (fuel_type_code) REFERENCES fuel_types(code), CONSTRAINT benzup_daily_prices_ck1 CHECK ( measurement_count > 0 AND price_sum > 0 AND price_sum NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND price_rub_per_liter = round(price_sum / measurement_count, 6) AND observed_date = (collected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date ) ); CREATE INDEX benzup_daily_prices_fk2_idx ON benzup_daily_prices(fuel_type_code); CREATE INDEX benzup_daily_prices_idx1 ON benzup_daily_prices(observed_date);
